director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
pata nahi
Aaj hum scale se lambai naapenge, metre aur centimetre mein. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi, aap batao

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Cricket bat ka handle bhi scale se naapte hain. Scale par 0 se 1, 1 se 2, har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Pencil 0 se 7 tak rakhi hai: 7 khaane, toh 7 centimetre. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: pata nahi
Crayon ke neeche wale khaane ek-ek karke gino, 3 wale nishaan se shuru karke. 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak rakhe crayon ki lambai kitni hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: hindi mein batao na
Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon. 3 se 9 tak ke khaane gino. Crayon kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: 3 se 9 tak ke khaane gino. Crayon kitne centimetre ka hai?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon.

director.text: 6 cm hai na

Bilkul sahi: 3 se 9 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 6 khaane hain, yaani 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Scale ka pehla khaana 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai. Jo cheez 1 se shuru hoti hai, uske neeche woh pehla khaana aata hi nahi. Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Patte ke neeche ka pehla khaana 1 aur 2 ke beech wala hai. Wahan se aakhri sire tak khaane gino. 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak rakha patta kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 7 centimetre

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki pehla khaana patte ke neeche nahi aata. Golu ka scale toot gaya, ab woh 4 se shuru hota hai. Uske khaane bhi 1-1 centimetre ke hain: cheez jahan se shuru ho, wahin se khaane gino. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: sawaal kya hai?
4 ke nishaan se rakhi 8 centimetre ki pencil ka doosra sira kis nishaan par hoga?
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: screen par dikhao na
Yahan wahi toota scale hai, aur pencil ke sire se ginti shuru karke dikhayi hai: 4 se 5 tak pehla khaana. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

seams.form: Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.

director.text: barah

Bilkul sahi. 4 se aage 8 khaane chalo toh 12 aata hai: 4 + 8 = 12. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Golu ka toota scale 4 ke nishaan se shuru hota hai. Uspar ek tehni 5 ke nishaan se 12 ke nishaan tak rakhi hai. Tehni ki lambai nikaalni hai. Tehni ki lambai ke liye 12 mein se kaunsa nishaan ghataoge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge.

director.text: Yeh jawab nahi hai. Tehni 5 se shuru hoti hai, scale ke 4 se nahi. Isliye 12 mein se 5 ghatayenge. Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Tehni ke ek sire se doosre sire tak ke khaane ek-ek karke gino. Toote scale par 5 se 12 tak rakhi tehni kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: saat

Haan, bilkul theek: 12 − 5 = 7 khaane tehni ke neeche hain, aur har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Toh poora jawab: tehni 7 centimetre lambi hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: pehle main try karun?
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise doosri tarah samajhte hain. Nishaan nahi, khaane gino. 2 se 5 tak teen khaane hain: 2 se 3, 3 se 4, aur 4 se 5. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 10 cm
Nahi, 10 cm theek nahi. 10 par chabi rukti hai, par shuru 6 par hoti hai; pehle wale khaane chabi mein nahi aate. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 10 cm
10 cm se baat nahi bani. Ungli 6 wale nishaan par rakho, aur 10 tak ek-ek khaana kood kar jao. Har kood ek centimetre hai. Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

seams.form: Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.

director.text: 4 cm lambi

Bilkul sahi, kyunki chabi ke neeche chaar khaane aate hain, 6 se 10 tak: 10 − 6 = 4. Ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Rubber 5 ke nishaan se shuru hota hai, toh 0 aur 5 ke beech ke khaane khaali pade hain; woh gine nahi jaate. 5 se 9 tak rakhe rubber ki lambai kitne centimetre hai?

Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: 9 cm
Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 4 cm hai, kyunki rubber ke neeche 5 se 6, 6 se 7, 7 se 8 aur 8 se 9: 4 khaane, toh 4 centimetre. Yahan tak theek hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Koi baat nahi, chalo aage badhte hain. Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, yeh naap le lene ke baad. Chalo, pehle yahan se aage badhte hain. Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?
director.card: Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

seams.form: Koi baat nahi, chalo aage badhte hain.
Chalo, pehle yahan se aage badhte hain.

director.text: laal
Bilkul sahi. Neela 3 se chalkar 9 tak jaata hai, toh bas 6 centimetre; laal poore 7, isliye laal lamba. Cricket mein kya kuch aisa hai jise tum naap sakte ho?
jab Virat chauka maarta hai, woh
Arre, chauka! Achha hua tumne bataya. Theek hai, ab phir se apne kaam par lagte hain. Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, ab phir se apne kaam par lagte hain.

j2.line: Arre, chauka! Achha hua tumne bataya.

director.text: nau cm

Haan, bilkul theek: ginti grip ke shuru wale 6 se hoti hai, toh 15 − 6 = 9 khaane, yaani 9 centimetre. Chhoti cheezein centimetre mein naapte hain. Ab dekhenge ki lambi cheezon ke liye metre kya hai, aur ek metre mein kitne centimetre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
mujhe nahi pata
Grip jaise, har cheez ke khaane wahin se gine jaate hain jahan woh shuru hoti hai. Ab aisi lambi cheezein aayengi jinke liye scale chhota padta hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
haan

Yeh ek metre ki lakdi hai. Ispar 0 se 100 tak centimetre likhe hain: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. Toh 1 metre mein 100 centimetre hote hain. Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: 70 cm
70 cm sahi nahi hai. 70 toh bat ki apni lambai hai; poocha yeh hai ki bat ke upar se metre ke aakhri nishaan tak kitna bacha. 70 ke nishaan tak aane wala bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: 30 centimetre chhota hai

Bilkul sahi, kyunki bat ke upar 70 se 100 tak 30 centimetre bacha. Yeh lamba feeta hai, jis par sirf 10-10 centimetre ke nishaan hain. Jahan metre ka number likha hai, wahan poora metre hota hai; do numberon ke beech das chhote khaane. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

director.text: 1 metre 4 cm

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Ek aur tareeka dekhte hain. Feete ka har chhota khaana 10 centimetre ka hai. Board par dekho: 10 aur 90 milkar poore 100 centimetre, yaani ek metre. Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?
director.card: Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?

director.text: 1 metre 3 cm

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. 1 metre 3 centimetre toh 1 metre ke thoda hi aage, pehle chhote khaane ke andar hota; mez teen poore khaane aage hai. Feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aane wali mez kitne metre aur centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?

director.text: 1 metre aur 30 centimetre

Haan, bilkul theek. 1 metre ke baad mez 3 chhote khaane aur jaati hai; 3 baar 10 yaani 30, kul 1 metre 30 centimetre. Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

seams.form: Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain.

director.text: 140 centimetre

Sahi jawab, kyunki parda 1 metre wale nishaan se 4 chhote khaane aage hai, har ek 10 centimetre, toh 1 metre 40 centimetre. 1 metre 5 centimetre ka matlab: ek poora metre, yaani 100 centimetre, aur 5 centimetre aur. Toh 105 centimetre. Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?

director.text: 28 cm

Nahi, 28 cm theek nahi. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. 4 metre 2 centimetre mein chaar poore metre hain, aur har metre 100 centimetre ka hai. Unke baad bas 2 centimetre aur, toh kul 402 centimetre. Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: 1 metre 5 centimetre ka pipe, 70 centimetre ka dhaaga, ya 90 centimetre ka danda?

director.text: danda

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. 1 metre 5 centimetre ko 15 padhne se metre chhota ho gaya; usmein 100 centimetre gino, phir teeno ko milao. 1 metre 5 centimetre ka pipe, 70 centimetre ka dhaaga, 90 centimetre ka danda: inmein sabse lamba kaun?
director.card: Inmein sabse lamba kaun hai: 1 metre 5 centimetre ka pipe, 70 centimetre ka dhaaga, ya 90 centimetre ka danda?

director.text: danda
Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Pehle 1 metre 5 centimetre ko poora centimetre mein likho. Phir teeno gintiyan milao. Tumhari baari hai, aaram se socho aur bolo.

Bilkul sahi. Pipe 1 metre 5 centimetre, yaani 105 centimetre hai, jo danda ke 90 aur dhaage ke 70 se zyada hai. Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?

director.text: 208 centimetre

Haan, bilkul theek: 2 metre = 200 centimetre, aur 200 + 8 = 208 centimetre. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Ek rassi 3 metre lambi hai. Usmein se 40 centimetre kaat diya. Kitni rassi bachi, metre aur centimetre mein? 40 centimetre ghatane se pehle 3 metre ka kya karoge?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: thak gayi, bye
Thakaan ho toh aaram karna bilkul theek hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain!
